Container.Name: rivflux
Container.Overview: Rivian vehicle data collector. Polls the Rivian API and writes telemetry (battery, range, charge state, cabin temp, mileage, etc.) to InfluxDB. Includes a built-in setup UI — open the WebUI after starting the container to authenticate with your Rivian account. Credentials are never stored; only the resulting session token is saved to the appdata volume.

Config.Name: Setup UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the setup web UI. Open this in your browser after starting the container to authenticate.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Directory where the Rivian session token is persisted between restarts.

Config.Name: InfluxDB Token
Config.Description: InfluxDB API token with write access to your Rivian bucket.

Config.Name: InfluxDB URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your InfluxDB instance, including protocol and port.

Config.Name: InfluxDB Bucket
Config.Description: InfluxDB bucket to write vehicle data into.

Config.Name: Poll Interval (seconds)
Config.Description: How often to poll the Rivian API. Default is 300 (5 minutes).
